contributions.title: Prove partial-prefix matching capacity for simple cube cycles
contributions.claim_excerpt:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves a necessary completion bound for a simple hypercube path and a functional that omits one coordinate. The bound counts unused matching edges and endpoint capacity, including the final edge to the start. It rejects prefixes that pass matching balance and return distance. This is an enabling proof with finite corroboration; there is no engine change, runtime claim or change to the complete kappa calculation (`60403/20000000`).

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fe3226ea4e36469f43c6b116c5b98cc221a9b1af/research/f7-prefix-matching-capacity/README.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fe3226ea4e36469f43c6b116c5b98cc221a9b1af/research/f7-prefix-matching-capacity/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fe3226ea4e36469f43c6b116c5b98cc221a9b1af/research/f7-prefix-matching-capacity/verify.py), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fe3226ea4e36469f43c6b116c5b98cc221a9b1af/research/f7-prefix-matching-capacity/SOURCES.json).

The written condition covers `n >= 2`, even `4 <= L <= 2^n`, and simple prefixes with 2 through L vertices. Universality is not required. The returned splits are necessary conditions, not certificates that a completion exists.

## Task and overlap

Answers Open next question 2 of [PR #4907](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4907). The sharp cap in [PR #4992](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4992) is related context, not a dependency. Base: `bee95ce88f9
